title: Ofishin Jakadancin a Tsohon Birni
intro: Gari mai ƙura, mutanensa sun makale cikin musantawa, da gargaɗin ƙarshe wanda ba a yi la'akari da shi ba. A yau, ku shiga cikin rawar da waɗanda Allah ya aiko don isar da saƙo ga mutane masu taurin kai. Labarin ƙin yarda, muryar imani ɗaya tilo, da ƙarshen da aka rufe da wani mummunan hukunci. Wa ke magana ta waɗannan alamu?
clues: Allah ne ya aiko mu zuwa ga wani gari wanda mutanensa suka kauce wa gaskiya
Mu biyu ne suka zo na farko, sannan na uku ya shiga don ƙarfafa manufarmu
Mutanen garin sun ƙi mu, suna cewa mu ba komai ba ne illa mutane kamar su
Wani mutum ɗaya daga ƙarshen birnin ya yi gudu don ya gaya wa mutane su bi mu
Mun yi musu addu'a, amma suka taurare zukatansu suka juya mana baya
A cikin wani mummunan ihu daga sama, an yi shiru a birninmu gaba ɗaya

identity.label: Wanene Ni?
options: Manzannin Gari a cikin Suratul Ya-Sin
Hawwariyyun (Almajiran Isa)
Masu Sihiri na Fadar Fir'auna
Ma'abota Asabar
Mutanen Giwa
identity.answer: Manzannin Gari a cikin Suratul Ya-Sin

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Mutanen gari sun ƙi su kuma sun kira su maƙaryata
An ƙone shi da rai a cikin babbar wuta mai zafi
Wani babban kifi ya haɗiye shi a cikin babban teku
An tilasta wa aikin gina wani ginshiƙi mai tsayi
An azabtar da shi a cikin rami mai cike da wuta
trial.answer: Mutanen gari sun ƙi su kuma sun kira su maƙaryata

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: Tsohon garin (al-Qaryah)
Babban tanderu mai walƙiya
Cikin babban kifi
Ginshiƙin da ke taɓa sararin sama
Dakin Allah Mai Tsarki (Ka'aba)

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An lalata garin da kururuwa guda ɗaya mai ban tsoro (Sayha)
An nutsar da azzalumin da rundunarsa a cikin teku da aka raba
An rikide mutanen zuwa birai da birai
Ruwan sama mai ƙarfi ya lalata birnin
Ambaliyar ruwa mai ƙarfi ta mamaye dukkan al'umma
outcome.answer: An lalata garin da kururuwa guda ɗaya mai ban tsoro (Sayha)

arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
verse: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you." (36:14)
